in_sanskrit.name: चामक्षी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Chamakshi is derived from the Sanskrit words 'chama' which means 'to be moved' and 'kshi' which means 'eyes'. This name is believed to denote the Goddess of Beauty and Grace, who has the power to move and captivate hearts with her enchanting charm.

in_hindi.name: चामक्षी
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Chamakshi in Hindi can be translated to 'She who holds the power to captivate'. This name is believed to reflect the charm and allure of the person named Chamakshi, who is able to captivate the hearts of those around her.

in_tamil.name: சாமக்ஷி
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, the name Chamakshi can be translated to 'She who enchants with her beauty'. This name is believed to reflect the captivating and enchanting nature of the person named Chamakshi, who is able to mesmerize those around her with her beauty and grace.

in_telugu.name: చామక్షీ
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, the name Chamakshi can be translated to 'She who moves the hearts'. This name is believed to reflect the ability of the person named Chamakshi to move and inspire those around her, as well as her own capacity for deep emotions and feelings.

in_marathi.name: Chamakshi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of eyes
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chamakshi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chamakshi is a Sanskrit name derived from the Devi Chamundeshwari, who is the Goddess of eyes. Chamundeshwari is depicted with multiple eyes to symbolize wisdom, knowledge, and the ability to see beyond the physical world. Chamakshi represents the divine power of sight and the importance of inner vision in spiritual growth.
